content: BLE MIDI: min connection interval 7.5 ms (macOS), 11.25/15 ms typical; NIME 2019 (Wang/Mulder/Wanderley) found macOS picked 11.25 ms, BLE added ~12 ms one way vs wired, round trip 29.9 ms +/- 15.0 ms vs 4.3 +/- 2.2 wired; jitter proportional to interval; 13-bit ms timestamps often ignored by receivers (Nordic blog).
